next-export-loader

A server-like loader lifecycle for the Next.js Pages Router under output: 'export' — the page component doesn't mount until its data is ready.

GitHub repository ↗

  • basic-list-detail→

    Loader basics, cache hits, navigation race, progress bar, devtools.

  • auth-gated→

    Redirect-before-mount auth gating.
  • permission-gated→

    Permission-based guards over a router-agnostic core: guard factory, redirect-return, 3-state session, token refresh.

  • dynamic-routes→

    Query-param routes, errorFallback on a failed loader.

  • search-with-suggest→

    Per-query keys and search-driven navigation races.

  • shallow-list-filter→

    URL-backed sort/filter via shallowPush — view-only changes that update the URL without re-running the loader (prototype).

Built with output: 'export' and deployed to GitHub Pages. Each example is an independent static Next.js app.
